projectDescription: A cross-chain interoperability monorepo providing a bridge, SDK, REST API, off-chain agents, and supporting infrastructure for the Synapse interchain messaging network.
keyFeatures: Cross-chain bridge supporting 19+ chains via SynapseBridge, SynapseCCTP, and SynapseRFQ modules
TypeScript SDK (@synapsecns/sdk-router) for programmatic bridge and swap interactions
Embeddable React bridge widget (@synapsecns/widget) for dApp integration
REST API at api.synapseprotocol.com for bridge quotes, transaction info, and status
OmniRPC: latency-aware, multi-provider RPC load balancer with response verification
Scribe: multi-chain event indexing service with GraphQL and gRPC APIs
CCTP Relayer for permissionless Circle CCTP cross-chain USDC transfers
RFQ (Request-for-Quote) relayer and guard for fast, intent-based bridging
Synapse Interchain Network (SIN): optimistic proof-of-stake off-chain messaging agents
Helm charts for Kubernetes deployment of all services
publicApiSurface: SynapseSDK.bridge(addressTo, routerAddress, originChainId, destChainId, tokenIn, amountIn, originQuery, destQuery)
Bridge widget: <Bridge web3Provider={...} customTheme={...} targetTokens={[...]} targetChainIds={[...]} />
REST API GET /bridge - get bridge quotes
REST API GET /bridge/v2 - get bridge quotes (v2)
REST API GET /bridgeTxInfo - get transaction calldata
REST API GET /bridgeTxStatus - check bridge tx completion
REST API GET /swap - get swap quotes
REST API GET /tokenlist - supported tokens per chain
REST API GET /destinationTokens - possible destination tokens
REST API GET /bridgeLimits - min/max bridgeable amounts
OmniRPC POST /rpc/{chainId} - proxied multi-confirmed RPC calls
Scribe GraphQL queries: lastIndexed, logsRange, blockTime, txSender
